title: Deep learning on endoscopic ultrasound images stratifies gastric GIST risk
summary: Models built on 1320 endoscopic ultrasound images from two hospitals were tested on 656 images from external cohorts. The four-category risk model had 74.50% accuracy and 55.00% sensitivity on external tumors, and the two-category model for very low-risk GISTs reached 86.25% accuracy and 94.44% sensitivity. The study is retrospective and image-level with modest four-class sensitivity.
